location.chapter: opening of the commentary on Sūtrasthāna 1

paraphrase: Homage to the lord of serpents (Śeṣa), who removed the faults of mind, speech and body by the Pātañjala (Yoga), the Mahābhāṣya and the redaction of Caraka; and homage to Brahmā, Dakṣa, the Aśvins, Indra, Bharadvāja, Punarvasu, Agniveśa, Caraka and the others.

original.licence: ancient text (public domain); e-text consulted read-only for reference

speaker: Cakrapāṇidatta
notes: The tradition's identification of the author of the Yoga Sūtra, the Mahābhāṣya and Caraka's redaction as one (Śeṣa); scholars distinguish them.
